# Platform.Storage.Cache.delete()

Deletes a temporary cache file.

## Syntax

<CodeBlock language="ts">
  <span style={{ display: 'inline' }}>SpotifyPlus.Platform.Storage.Cache.delete(path: string): void</span>
</CodeBlock>

## Examples

The following example shows how an extension can discard old search results after a fresh search.

```ts
// Discard old search results after a fresh search.
const results = await SpotifyPlus.Search.search('After Hours');
if (results.items.length > 0) {
  SpotifyPlus.Platform.Storage.Cache.delete('search/after-hours.json');
  console.log('Removed stale search cache');
}
```

## Parameters

`path`

<Badge>string</Badge> <Badge variant="danger">Required</Badge>

A path relative to this extension’s storage area.
